title: Payload tape scan
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose the forward and find-mode settings, and let $s,d$ be controller phases. Suppose that in phase $s$, for every input symbol and scanned-work-tape tuple, the host moves the payload head left and stays in phase $s$ when the scanned payload cell is nonblank, and moves it right and enters phase $d$ when that cell is blank. For any Boolean input $x$, base configuration $b$, input-head position $p$, flag and counter tapes, counter-head position $h$, Boolean word $w$, output word $o$, and natural number $j\le |w|$, starting with the payload tape storing $w$ and its head at position $j-1$, the host reaches after $j+1$ steps the frame with phase $d$, unchanged other specified data, and payload head at position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite machines B and F
transition condition htr for every input and work tuple
